import os
import sys

cwd = os.getcwd()
print("CWD:", cwd)

# Locate budget.xlsx
candidates = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(cwd):
    # skip hidden dirs like .git
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
    for f in files:
        if f.lower() == 'budget.xlsx':
            candidates.append(os.path.join(root, f))
    if candidates:
        break

print("Found:", candidates)

if not candidates:
    sys.exit("budget.xlsx not found")

path = candidates[0]

import pandas as pd
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)

for name in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=name, header=None)
    print("\n===== Sheet:", name, "shape:", df.shape, "=====")
    with pd.option_context('display.max_rows', None, 'display.max_columns', None, 'display.width', 200):
        print(df.to_string())

import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)

for name in xl.sheet_names:
    df = xl.parse(name, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} | shape={df.shape} ===")
    with pd.option_context("display.max_rows", 300, "display.max_columns", 60, "display.width", 300):
        print(df.to_string())

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True, read_only=True)
ws = wb.active
print('SHEET:', ws.title)
for row in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True):
    print(row)

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name=None)
for name, d in df.items():
    print('SHEET:', name)
    print(d.to_string())
print('TOTAL_EXPENSES_OVERALL:', sum(d.sum(numeric_only=True).sum() for d in df.values()))

from openpyxl import load_workbook
wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True)
ws = wb.active
nums = [c.value for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row if isinstance(c.value, (int, float))]
print('sheet:', ws.title, 'numeric_cells:', len(nums))
print('grand_total:', sum(nums))
